# The wide frames (rd_sideband_ab, rd_region_camera_ab): a fixture, its frame's
# aspect (the replays' --aspect), then the line's own properties
# (rd_fixture_list_props.cmake), each under the rule its test replays:
# side_band_card_draws (--stats) and region_drops, beside_tris (--region-stats)
# under the PS2's rule, camera_drawn_tris (--region-stats) under the camera
# rule; region_rule_draws is the fixture's own.  Every fixture is made with
# @scene drops (docs/port/TESTING_FIXTURES.md, "The placement rules"): a floor
# across the eye plane and a card beyond the GS window, each facing the eye and
# facing away, so the PS2 drops triangles that the side bands draw beside the
# picture (a frame wider than 4:3) and the camera rule draws.
#
# the PowerVR phone's one 4:3 frame: the control (the band is the frame: no
# side bands, nothing beside the picture; the camera rule draws the drops)
fx-drops-6818 4:3 side_band_card_draws=0 region_drops>=1 beside_tris=0 camera_drawn_tris>=1
# the PowerVR phone, GS 848x448 at 2.189
fx-drops-4657 2.189 side_band_card_draws>=1 region_drops>=1 beside_tris>=1 camera_drawn_tris>=1
# issue 189, GS 624x448 at 16:10 (stage 32's exit)
fx-drops-189 16:10 side_band_card_draws>=1 region_drops>=1 beside_tris>=1 camera_drawn_tris>=1
# the Mali-G52 reporter's frame (issue 179), GS 912x512 at its own 2.3704 (full
# height); a 16:9 fixture of a version 15+ dump does not exist (issue 102's gate,
# version 11, has no facing tables: the side bands' mode holds none of its draws)
fx-drops-mali 2.3704 side_band_card_draws>=1 region_drops>=1 beside_tris>=1 camera_drawn_tris>=1
# the main gate, GS 2048x448 at 48:9
